title: Quantum relative entropy regularization for quantum state tomography
summary: The density matrix is a positive semidefinite operator of trace 1 characterizing the state of a quantum system. We consider the inverse problem to reconstruct such density matrices from indirect measurements, also known as quantum state tomography. To solve such inverse problems in high or infinite dimensional settings, we study variational regularization using the quantum relative entropy as penalty functional.
